description: Transvaalbuurt 1921 plain flat rows (Retiefstraat 194-268, Tugelaweg 50-62): 6.2 m dark brown brick fronts of a ground storey and three upper storeys of flats, every storey the same: a wide white-framed window of two casements under two top lights on the left axis and a narrow one on the right axis (the stair), the red portiek door under it; no balconies, no bays; a deep dark brick frieze over the top windows under a thin pale gutter board on a short overhang at about 13 m, no roof face seen from the street

match.note: 3DBAG eaves 12.4-13.2 m on Retiefstraat 194-268 (strip gutter 13.0-13.2 m, skyline 13.1-13.6 m where read), bouwlagen 4-5, BAG 1921. The front repeats in runs, not in pairs: the wide axis is on the left of Retiefstraat 194-204 and on the right of 246-262 (2020 strip), and the door is rarely read, so the photo decides the side (auto-place --photo-decides tries both). The 8.7-9.4 m corner and gable pands (Retiefstraat 212, 220, 240) draw the same two axes wider; the 1921 oriel rows of Retiefstraat 2-28 and Tugelaweg 19-31 are 17.8-18.3 m stair blocks with two canted brick bays each and fall outside the width

gutter.note: a thin pale gutter board at 13.0-13.3 m over a dark soffit, 0.45 m out (Retiefstraat 194-204, 2020 strip); the frieze of dark headers under it (11.2-12.6 m, a row of dentils at 11.6 m) is the brick wall

door-right.note: the red portiek door on the narrow right axis

roof.evidence: the 2020 strip of Retiefstraat 194-268 shows sky straight over the gutter board on every pand (skyline 13.1-13.6 m): no roof face is seen from the street; the 3DBAG roof over it (16.8-17.0 m) stands back from the front

rhythm.bays: a wide window axis (2.2 m) on the left, a narrow stair axis (0.9 m) on the right
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window + door | 1-3: wide window + narrow window
rhythm.symmetry: the same front repeated in runs; Retiefstraat 246-262 is the mirror of 194-204
rhythm.groundFloor: flats; the portiek door on the narrow axis
rhythm.roofline: a thin pale gutter board on a short overhang, no roof face

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020 at 40 px/m: 6.2 m pands; a wide window 2.2-2.3 m across at 0.2-2.9 m from the pand's left, a narrow window 0.9-1.2 m at 4.3-5.9 m; window rows 2.2-4.5, 5.6-7.7, 8.95-10.95 m on the strip (3.35 m pitch; the strip foot cuts the ground storey); gutter board 13.05 m, dark soffit band 12.4-13.0 m, dentil row at 11.6 m; red doors under the narrow axis
Retiefstraat 246-262 on the same strip: the mirrored front, the wide window 2.25 m at 2.6-4.9 m from the pand's left, the narrow windows at the left party lines

schemaLimits: the dentil course and dark header frieze under the gutter are plain brick
the narrow side lights beside the wide casements are not drawn
